**Note tools**: strum, arpeggiate, flip, limit, randomise, scale levels, plus scale snap, zoom presets and step graph lanes.
Browser search, quick-add palette, undo history panel and shortcut sheet. On Windows, `.lynx` files open in LYNX SHARE with their own icon.
better: **Mouse handling** in the Piano roll and Playlist: tools, clip edges, slip/trim, time selection, ripple, knife and inline automation.
**Channel rack and Mixer**: Channel rack multi-select, move and clone; compact Mixer strips with peak hold and a routing lane; effect slot reordering, A/B compare and presets.
**FL generators on their exact engines**: MiniSynth, Fruity DX10, Fruit Kick, BassDrum, PoiZone, Toxic Biohazard, Kepler, 3x Osc, GMS, Morphine, Ogun and Harmor (additive engine and effects rack).

**FL effects on their exact engines**: Fruity Limiter and Compressor, Reeverb 2, Parametric EQ 2, WaveShaper, Soft Clipper, Fruity Delay 2 and 3, Stereo Shaper, Gross Beat, Maximus, Soundgoodizer and others.

title: Sakura, Drumpad, BooBass and other FL plugins rebuilt
summary: More FL Studio generators and effects rebuilt from their own engines, each checked against FL's DLLs. This matters if you open .flp projects that use them.
new: **Sakura**: physical string model with its modulation matrix, envelope, LFO, resonators, chorus, reverb and delay.
**Drumpad**: physical drum model (mallet, comb bank, filters, hold, lo-fi).
**BooBass**: FL's engine. Its multisample is read at run time from your own FL Studio installation; LYNX SHARE never ships it.
better: **Other generators**: Toxic Biohazard gets FL's 4-pole ladder filter, Kepler its Chorus I / II / I+II, Harmless stereo tremolo and vibrato, and in Ogun each partial decays at its own rate.
**Effects**: Effector's Filter, Flanger and Phaser match FL's engine, and Fruity Squeeze and Vintage Phaser are exact effects. Love Philter gets FL's pan law, pan-LFO tension and pulse curves.
Plugin-model channels get their own knob panels.

title: Export crash fix, ASIO drivers, closer FL Studio imports
summary: A stability fix for a crash that hit about 1 in 10 exports, ASIO drivers, and closer imports of several FL Studio plugins.
new: **ASIO audio drivers**, next to Windows Audio and DirectSound. `LYNX.exe --devicetest "ASIO" "<driver>" report.txt` checks a driver silently.
**Vocoder side inputs**: modulator and carrier from other mixer tracks (Modulator from / Carrier from).
better: **FL Studio import**: Ogun's spectrum with each partial's own decay, Harmor's resonance as a filter peak, Sytrus harmonic carriers, Vocodex converted to the vocoder with its two side inputs, and Love Philter's cutoff/resonance envelopes and LFOs in every unit.
**VST3 automation** follows FL's persistent parameter slots. Plugins installed as both VST3 and CLAP match the format FL Studio used.
Crash backtraces are written to the autosave folder in every mode.
fixed: **Random crash while exporting or playing** (about 1 in 10 exports): a race in the mixer's worker threads could run one track twice.

title: First public release
summary: The first public release of LYNX SHARE, a lightweight DAW with the FL Studio workflow. It opens, plays and exports whole projects, but it is not yet a daily-driver DAW.
new: **Channel rack, Piano roll, Playlist and Mixer**: the Playlist has multiple arrangements; the Mixer has sends, sidechain and 10 slots per track.
**Instruments**: a 3-oscillator synth (with a harmonics oscillator), a sampler with time-stretch and built-in drums.
**Effects**: 7-band parametric EQ, compressor with sidechain, limiter, delay, reverb, chorus, Effector, vocoder, pitch correction, lo-fi and more.
**VST3 and CLAP plugins**, optionally in a separate process.
**FL Studio .flp import**: channels, samples, patterns, arrangement, automation, mixer and 40+ native plugins. `.mid` files import too.
**Export** to WAV, FLAC and OGG.
known: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) only.
The executable is not code-signed yet: Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch.
